intake.title: Textarea: multi-line text field
intake.problem: Forms need longer free text: tournament descriptions, event notes, registration comments, dispute reasons. Lock In only has the single-line InputField, so products either stretch an InputField (text can't wrap) or hand-build a textarea that drifts from the field chrome, error wiring and focus ring the system already defines.

evidence.note: Built locally as Field / Textarea on Lock In tokens. Desktop and mobile.

evidence.where: Event setup (next step after Create tournament): event notes and payout terms
evidence.note: Planned in the Review step's “Set up your first event” callout.

evidence.where: Match scoring: dispute / note on a score
Any feedback, comment, bio or support form
evidence.note: Standard form control in every comparable system (Primer, Carbon, Polaris, Material).

closestExisting.name: InputField
closestExisting.whyNotExtend: InputField renders <input>, which cannot wrap or grow. Adding a multiline prop would change the element, the keyboard behaviour (Enter submits vs inserts a newline) and the native mapping (TextInput multiline), and would leave suffix, iconStart and type=password meaningless. A sibling component that shares the field chrome (.ds-field, .ds-control, Field / Label, Hint, Error) is cleaner.

standIn.description: VolleyXP Field / Textarea: Lock In Field / Label + Field / Hint instances around a control frame using color.surface.default, color.border.default, radius.md and typography.body.md.

figmaApi.default: Open to all skill levels. Cash payouts in advanced divisions, trophies for all.
Shown on the public tournament page.

openQuestions: Native: no resize handle and no auto-grow cap in React Native without measuring; confirm maxRows behaviour on device.

resolved.question: Hint position: InputField code renders the hint above the control, but the Figma InputField and the VolleyXP designs put it below. This draft follows the code (above); decide once for every field.
resolved.answer: Follow the code: hint above the control for every field. When Textarea is built, also move the hint above the control in the Figma InputField and Select components (and the VolleyXP stand-ins) in the same change; no separate proposal.

resolved.question: Should Textarea have a size prop (sm / md / lg) like InputField, or is rows enough? The draft uses rows and keeps body.md text so iOS never zooms.
resolved.answer: rows only, no size prop. Primer, Carbon, Polaris, Material and Spectrum size textareas by rows; InputField size only sets control height, which rows already covers, and the text stays body.md (16px) to avoid iOS zoom.

resolved.question: Counter: hard limit (maxLength blocks typing, the draft's choice) or soft limit (allow over, show invalid)? Soft limits keep pasted text but need an error.
resolved.answer: Hard limit: maxLength blocks typing past the limit; the counter turns text.warning within 10% and announces at the threshold and at the limit.

decision.note: Released: Textarea 0.1.0 in @lockin/react and @lockin/react-native (#23), Code Connect fixed (#24, #25) and published, Figma library published 2026-11-01. VolleyXP Bracket Creator now uses the library Textarea.

spec.name: Textarea
spec.purpose: Multi-line text entry for free text longer than a line (descriptions, notes, comments), with the same label, hint, error and counter wiring as InputField.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Placeholders are not labels.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Visually hide the label (keeps the accessible name).

props.name: hint
props.description: Guidance about what to write, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; sets aria-invalid. Say how to fix it.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible lines before scrolling (the minimum height when autoGrow is on).

props.name: autoGrow
props.description: Grow with the content up to maxRows, then scroll.

props.name: resize
props.description: Whether the user can drag to resize. Ignored when autoGrow is on.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Hard character limit. Pair with showCount so people can see it.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Show a “86 / 500” counter under the field. Needs maxLength.

props.name: showOptional
props.description: Show '(optional)' instead; use when most fields are required.

states.name: default
states.description: border.strong outline, rows × line height tall.

states.name: focus
states.description: Focus ring + border.selected on the control.

states.name: filled
states.description: Has a value; counter shows the length when showCount is on.

states.name: near limit
states.description: Within 10% of maxLength: counter turns text.warning and is announced once.

states.name: invalid
states.description: 2px border.danger, error message with icon below.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled background and text; not resizable.

tokens.usage: Gap between label, control, hint and counter.
Entered text: 16px minimum prevents iOS zoom.
Line height used to size rows / maxRows.

keyboard.action: Inserts a new line. It never submits the form.
Not handled by Textarea; a form may opt in to submit with it.

screenReader: Announces label, required state, “multi-line”, value, then hint, counter and error via aria-describedby.
The counter is not a live region on every keystroke. A polite live region announces “20 characters left” once when the 10% threshold is crossed and “Character limit reached” at the limit.
accessibility.focus: Focus ring on the whole control (focus-within), same as InputField.
accessibility.touchTarget: At least 44px tall on touch (rows ≥ 2 always exceeds it).
notes: Validate on blur or submit, not on every keystroke.
If maxLength is set, say the limit in the hint or show the counter; silently blocking typing fails 3.3.2.
Keep the resize handle at least 24×24 and don't remove it unless autoGrow is on.

variants.name: with counter
variants.useWhen: Text has a real limit (public descriptions, SMS-length notes).

variants.name: auto-grow
variants.description: Grows from rows to maxRows, then scrolls.
variants.useWhen: Comments and notes where length varies a lot.

do: Use Textarea when answers are usually longer than one line; use InputField otherwise.
Size rows to the expected answer (3 for a short description, 5–6 for notes).
Show the limit with showCount whenever maxLength is set.
dont: Don't use the placeholder as the label or as the only instructions.
Don't make Enter submit the form.
Don't disable resize on a fixed-height field that people may need to read back.

related.name: InputField
related.reason: Single-line text; shares the field chrome.

related.name: Select
related.reason: Choosing from predefined values instead of writing them.

example.web:
<Textarea label="Description" showOptional hint="Shown on the public tournament page." rows={3} maxLength={500} showCount />
<Textarea label="Match notes" autoGrow maxRows={6} error={errors.notes} />
